# Emigration Aid — Complete Site Content

> Emigration Aid (legally Jamal Associates & Emigration Aid) is a leading visa and education consultancy headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Founded in September 2009 by Khan Abu Rawshan Md Mostofa Jamal, the firm specializes in student recruitment, skilled immigration pathways, and end-to-end visa processing for individuals seeking to study or migrate abroad. With 17+ years of experience, 500+ successful placements, and partnerships across 20+ destination countries, Emigration Aid is one of Bangladesh's most experienced immigration consultancies.

---

## Services

### Student Recruitment & Placement
University selection, course matching, application filing, and student visa preparation for 20+ countries. We work with prospective students to identify the best-fit universities and programs based on their academic profile, career goals, and budget. Our team handles the entire application process from document preparation to submission, and provides comprehensive student visa guidance including financial documentation, statement of purpose review, and interview preparation.

### Skilled Immigration
Permanent residency pathway mapping, credential assessment (ECA), Express Entry profiling, and job placement assistance. For professionals seeking to migrate through skilled worker programs, we provide end-to-end immigration consulting covering eligibility assessment, points calculation, application filing, and post-landing support. We specialize in Canadian Express Entry, Australian Skilled Migration (subclass 189/190/491), and UK Skilled Worker visas.

### One-on-One Counseling
Personalized sessions covering career goals, scholarship matching, financial auditing, and visa roadmaps. Every client receives dedicated time with an experienced counselor who evaluates their profile, discusses realistic pathways, identifies scholarship opportunities, and creates a customized action plan with timelines and milestones.

### Pre-Departure Briefings
Flight orientation, health coverage setup, international banking, and safety guidelines. Before departure, we conduct comprehensive briefing sessions that cover airport procedures, accommodation arrangements, cultural adjustment tips, health insurance enrollment, banking setup in the destination country, and emergency contact protocols.

### Post-Arrival Assistance
Airport pickup coordination, housing shortlists, and part-time job mentoring. Our support extends beyond visa approval — we help students and migrants settle into their new environment with airport reception arrangements, temporary and permanent housing options, local orientation, and guidance on part-time employment regulations and opportunities.

---

## Destination Countries

Emigration Aid supports university placements and immigration pathways for 20+ destination countries worldwide. Our primary focus areas include:

- **Australia**: Student visas (subclass 500), skilled migration (subclass 189/190/491), and graduate visas. Partner universities across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, and Adelaide.
- **New Zealand**: Student visas, skilled migrant category, and post-study work visas. University and polytechnic placements across Auckland, Wellington, and Christchurch.
- **Canada**: Study permits, Express Entry (Federal Skilled Worker, Canadian Experience Class), Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs), and LMIA-based work permits.
- **United Kingdom**: Student visas (Tier 4/Student Route), Skilled Worker visas, and Graduate Route visas. University placements across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.
- **United States**: F-1 student visas, J-1 exchange visitor visas, and H-1B skilled worker visas. University placements across all 50 states.
- **Hungary**: Student visas for medical, engineering, and business programs. Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship applications.
- **France**: Campus France applications, student visas, and post-study work permits. Programs taught in English and French.
- **Germany**: Student visas for tuition-free public universities, Studienkolleg pathways, and job-seeker visas.
- **Finland**: Student residence permits for degree programs at Finnish universities and universities of applied sciences.
- **Sweden**: Student residence permits, Swedish Institute scholarship applications, and post-study work permits.
- **Malta**: Student visas for English language courses, undergraduate and postgraduate programs.
- **Europe & More**: Additional destinations including Ireland, Netherlands, Denmark, Norway, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Poland, Czech Republic, and other European nations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What services does Emigration Aid offer?
Emigration Aid is a premium immigration and study abroad consultancy based in Dhaka. We offer end-to-end services including student recruitment & placement, skilled immigration pathways, personalized career counseling, visa application filing, pre-departure briefings, and post-arrival assistance.

### Which countries can I study or migrate to through Emigration Aid?
We support university placements and immigration pathways for 20+ destination countries. Our primary focus areas include Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, the United States, Germany, France, Finland, Sweden, Hungary, Malta, and various other European nations.

### How long has Emigration Aid been operating?
Emigration Aid (legally Jamal Associates & Emigration Aid) was founded in September 2009 by Khan Abu Rawshan Md Mostofa Jamal. We have over 17 years of experience in immigration consulting and have successfully guided more than 500 students and professionals.

### Where is the Emigration Aid office located in Dhaka?
Our headquarters is located at Suite A4, Toma Angelica, 280/1-281/1 North Shahjahanpur, Dhaka 1217, Bangladesh. We are open Saturday through Thursday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Fridays.

### How can I book a consultation?
You can book a free, no-obligation session by filling out our online consultation form directly on our website, messaging our counseling team on WhatsApp (+8801769048022), or calling our office directly.

### What is Emigration Aid's visa success rate?
Over 17 years and 500+ client engagements, Emigration Aid has maintained a high visa approval success rate across all destination countries. Our thorough document preparation, interview coaching, and compliance-first approach ensure that applications are well-prepared before submission.

### Do you help with scholarship applications?
Yes. Our counselors actively identify and match eligible students with scholarships, fee waivers, and funding opportunities at partner universities. We assist with scholarship application essays, financial documentation, and deadline management.

### Is the initial consultation free?
Yes. We offer a free, no-obligation initial consultation where our experienced counselors evaluate your profile, discuss realistic pathways, and outline a customized plan. You can book online, via WhatsApp, or by calling our office.

## About Emigration Aid

### Company History
Emigration Aid, formerly known as Jamal Associates, has been bridging the career pathway to global education and skilled migration since 2009. Founded by Khan Abu Rawshan Md Mostofa Jamal in Dhaka, Bangladesh, the firm has grown from a small consultancy into one of the country's most trusted immigration advisory services.

### Our Mission
To provide comprehensive support and guidance to students aspiring to study in top-tier universities and colleges worldwide. We aim to bridge the gap between students' educational goals and the opportunities available in prestigious institutions across the globe, ensuring a smooth transition to their desired destinations.

### Our Vision
To be the leading education consultancy firm recognized for excellence in student recruitment and support services, empowering students to achieve their full potential through high-quality education abroad.

### Core Values
- **Integrity**: We adhere to the highest ethical standards in all our dealings, ensuring 100% transparency.
- **Excellence**: We strive for excellence in all our services, client interactions, and placement success.
- **Commitment**: We are deeply committed to the long-term success and complete satisfaction of our clients.
- **Innovation**: We continually seek innovative ways to improve our support programs and application pathways.

### Founder
**Khan Abu Rawshan Md Mostofa Jamal** — Chief Executive. "Our mission is to provide comprehensive support and guidance to students and skilled professionals aspiring to study and build careers in top-tier global destinations. We believe in ethical consultation, transparency, and bridging opportunities for a bright future."
